source_notes: Trait 2 source says reload speed +30%; reload_time_multiplier is derived as 1 / 1.3 = 0.76923. Pierce bonus is +1.
Trait 3 source: additional projectile +1 and reload time +20%.
Trait 4 source says fire speed -25%; shot_interval_multiplier is represented as 1.25 for a slower interval. Additional projectile bonus is +2.
Trait 5 source: power +25% and lightning branch chance +35%.
Branch Circuit source: branch on hit, branch count 2, branch damage 60%, search radius 4.5, power +35%, magazine +2.
Overcharged Barrage source: pierce +2, additional projectile +2, fire speed -20%, power +45%, shock 2 stacks on hit. shot_interval_multiplier is represented as 1.2 for a slower interval.
